name: Josh Adkins
title: Solution Architect & Data Engineer
summary: Solution architect and data engineer with 10+ years in enterprise healthcare data. I turn raw, fragmented healthcare data into scalable, secure cloud systems that power better decisions and real financial impact, with experience spanning Cerner, Epic, and modern lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS).

bullets: Partner with quality and clinical stakeholders to drive performance across HEDIS, CMS Star Ratings, Joint Commission, Leapfrog and HCAHPS.
Advise a legacy-to-cloud data modernization effort built to scale with the organization.
Run an advisory venture helping teams make smarter decisions about data, from modern cloud architecture to healthcare analytics strategy.
Guide partners through complex problems with clear thinking and pragmatic design.
Designed scalable, secure architectures integrating enterprise healthcare clients with Cedar Pay, Pre and Cover.
Simplified billing complexity and streamlined revenue cycle operations while ensuring seamless interoperability with EHRs and legacy systems.
Led the design and implementation of cloud-native data pipelines and warehouse architectures for structured and unstructured data.
Aligned data strategy with business goals and enforced governance, validation and quality frameworks.
Built scalable, cloud-native data solutions that helped healthcare organizations modernize their analytics infrastructure.
Delivered robust pipelines and cloud migrations optimized for performance and cost.
Implemented governance frameworks that maintained data integrity and compliance.
Promoted from Senior Analytics Engineer to lead a team of consulting analysts.
Translated executive objectives into analytics strategy using Tableau, Alteryx and Power BI.
Integrated Databricks, Spark and Azure, and championed SAFe Agile delivery.
Advanced through four progressively senior roles on the data warehousing team.
Built HIPAA-compliant pipelines and integration frameworks.
Worked extensively with Cerner EMR and the Epic Nexus transition, and supported enterprise-scale system acquisitions.

projects.title: Unified billing platform integration
projects.text: Led multiple CedarPay implementations across enterprise healthcare organizations, building a reusable Athena-based code-generation framework that cut developer effort by hundreds of hours and timelines by up to 50%.

projects.title: Cloud-native AWS data platform
projects.text: Designed and built a streaming-enabled AWS platform integrating siloed healthcare data sources into a scalable architecture, improving real-time analytics and business intelligence.

projects.title: Population health data migration
projects.text: Led population-health initiatives streamlining payer and community-program data into Databricks on Azure, improving accessibility and supporting actionable insights.

projects.title: Data modernization strategy
projects.text: Centralized pharmacy, medicine and ordering data in Snowflake and DBT, driving cost, adherence and dispensing-trend analysis.

projects.title: Large-scale cloud migration
projects.text: Executed a large-scale migration of on-premise systems to Azure-based infrastructure, enhancing scalability, security and real-time analytics across the network.

projects.title: Quality metrics enhancement
projects.text: Built data pipelines and reporting frameworks to track and improve HEDIS, CMS Star Ratings, Joint Commission, Leapfrog and HCAHPS measures, driving higher hospital ratings, stronger patient satisfaction and improved reimbursement.
